rows.question: What is the annual premium of PA Plus Silver for occupation class 3?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The annual premium of PA Plus Silver for occupation class 3 is 2,490 THB [01_PA_Plus_Personal_Accident.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: What is the maximum entry age for PA Plus?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The maximum entry age for PA Plus is 65 years old [01_PA_Plus_Personal_Accident.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: Is an injury covered if the insured was drunk?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: No, an injury is not covered if the insured was drunk. PA Plus does not cover injuries while under the influence of alcohol with blood alcohol above 150 mg% [01_PA_Plus_Personal_Accident.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: What is the Life Secure 20 premium for a 40-year-old male non-smoker per 1 million sum assured?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The Life Secure 20 premium for a 40-year-old male non-smoker per 1 million sum assured is 5,600 THB [02_Life_Secure_Term_Life.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: How much more do smokers pay for Life Secure?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: Smokers pay 40% more than the non-smoker premium for Life Secure [02_Life_Secure_Term_Life.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: Above what sum assured is a medical examination required for Life Secure?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: A medical examination is required for Life Secure if the sum assured is above 3,000,000 THB [02_Life_Secure_Term_Life.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: What is the general waiting period of Health Care Plus?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The general waiting period of Health Care Plus is 30 days from the policy start date. Accidents are covered from day one [03_Health_Care_Plus.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: What is the waiting period for cataract surgery?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The waiting period for cataract surgery is 120 days from the policy start date [03_Health_Care_Plus.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: How much is Health Care Plus Plan Plus per year for a 35-year-old?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The annual premium for Health Care Plus Plan Plus for a 35-year-old is 15,900 THB [03_Health_Care_Plus.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: How long is the free-look period for a new policy?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The free-look period for a new policy is 15 days from the date the customer receives the policy document. For policies sold by telephone, the free-look period is 30 days [04_Sales_Guide_Underwriting_FAQ.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: Is there an extra charge for paying monthly?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: Yes, there is an extra charge for paying monthly. A 3% charge applies to monthly payments [04_Sales_Guide_Underwriting_FAQ.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: Is there a discount for buying two products?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: Yes, there is a 5% multi-product discount when a customer holds two or more InsureX products [04_Sales_Guide_Underwriting_FAQ.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: How quickly are claims paid after all documents are received?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: Complete claims are paid within 15 days of receiving all documents [05_Claims_and_Service_Guide.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: What is the call centre phone number?
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: The call centre phone number is 02-123-4567 [05_Claims_and_Service_Guide.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: ประกันสุขภาพลดหย่อนภาษีได้สูงสุดเท่าไหร่
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: ประกันสุขภาพสามารถลดหย่อนภาษีได้สูงสุด 25,000 บาทต่อปี [03_Health_Care_Plus.pdf, p.1].

rows.question: ถ้าจ่ายเบี้ยไม่ตรงเวลา มีระยะเวลาผ่อนผันกี่วัน
rows.path: classify > contextualize > retrieve > grade > generate > update_memory
rows.answer: หากจ่ายเบี้ยไม่ตรงเวลา มีระยะเวลาผ่อนผัน 31 วัน [04_Sales_Guide_Underwriting_FAQ.pdf, p.1].
